OUR MISSION

Why We Exist

"Beautifying the life of our fellow brothers and sisters who can't afford social expenses and empowering them to also support others in the future."

Insha'Allah, every single cent you donate goes directly to those who need it most — orphans, widows, struggling families, and communities without clean water or a place to pray. We exist because the Prophet ﷺ taught us: "The best of people are those most beneficial to people."

From Mbale City, Uganda, we reach out across East Africa with your trust and generosity. Together, we are not just building wells or distributing Qurans — we are building futures. May Allah accept from all of us. Ameen.

See Our Services 🐑

"Whoever saves one life, it is as if he has saved all of mankind."

— Surah Al-Ma'idah 5:32

WHAT WE DO

Our Services

Every service we offer is an opportunity to earn Jannah. Choose your cause and make a difference today — Jazaakallah Khayr! 🤲

🐑

Qurban (Udhiyah)

Honor the Sunnah of Ibrahim ﷺ. Your Qurban feeds hungry families who otherwise go without meat on Eid. Let's share the joy of Eid Al-Adha together, Insha'Allah.

Donate Qurban →
💰

Zakat & Dawa

Purify your wealth and fulfil your Fard. We ensure your Zakat reaches the most deserving — those in debt, the poor, and those who need guidance to Islam.

Pay Zakat →
👶

Orphan Sponsorship

The Prophet ﷺ said: "I and the one who sponsors an orphan will be in Jannah like this" — and he joined his fingers together. Sponsor a child's education, food, and future today.

Sponsor an Orphan →
🚨

Emergency Relief

When disaster strikes — floods, drought, famine — families lose everything overnight. Be there for them in their darkest hour. Your urgent donation can save lives today.

Give Emergency Aid →
💧

Water Projects

"The best form of Sadaqah Jariyah is giving water." Every well drilled in your name continues to reward you long after you're gone. Give the gift of clean water today.

Fund a Water Well →
🕌

Masjid Projects

"Whoever builds a mosque for Allah, Allah will build for him a house in Jannah." Help us build and maintain mosques so communities have a place to worship Allah.

Build a Masjid →
👩‍🦳

Widow Care

She has lost her husband, her support. We stand by her — providing food, shelter assistance, and dignity. The Prophet ﷺ described one who cares for widows as a warrior in Allah's path.

Support Widows →
🌙

Ramadan Aid

Double your rewards in the most blessed month. We distribute iftar meals, Zakat Al-Fitr, and food packages to ensure no Muslim goes hungry during Ramadan. Masha'Allah!

Give Ramadan Aid →
📖

Quran Distribution

Every time someone reads the Quran you gifted them, you earn reward. Distribute the Word of Allah — a Sadaqah Jariyah that lasts generations. May Allah accept. Ameen.

Distribute Qurans →

TRUST & TRANSPARENCY

Why Donate to Hakam?

Barakallahu Feekum — your trust is a sacred amanah to us. Here's why thousands choose Hakam Charity.

✅

100% Reaches Those in Need

Insha'Allah, every dirham and shilling you donate reaches our beneficiaries directly. No hidden admin fees eating into your sadaqah. We operate with full transparency and accountability.

🤲

Rooted in Islamic Values

Everything we do is guided by the Quran and Sunnah. We prioritize the most vulnerable — orphans, widows, the poor — exactly as our beautiful religion teaches us. May Allah reward you.

🌍

Community-Driven Impact

Based in Mbale City, Uganda, we are part of the community we serve. We know our brothers and sisters personally. Your donation doesn't disappear — you can follow its journey with us.

📊

Proven Track Record

Alhamdulillah — over 500 orphans sponsored, 100+ water wells built, and 10,000+ Qurans distributed. Our impact speaks for itself. Join the growing family of Hakam donors today.

🔒

Secure Giving Options

From international transfers to mobile money, we've made it easy and safe for our brothers and sisters worldwide to donate with confidence. Multiple verified channels available.

🌙

Sadaqah Jariyah Opportunities

Many of our projects — water wells, Quran distribution, Masjid construction — are ongoing Sadaqah Jariyah. Your reward continues even after this life. SubhanAllah, what a gift!

🤲 100% of Your Donation Reaches Those in Need, Insha'Allah

We solemnly pledge before Allah that every donation is handled with complete honesty and trust. Our volunteers operate without salaries — every cent, every shilling goes to our brothers and sisters in need. "And Allah is Witness over all things." (Surah An-Nisa 4:33)

"Who is it that would loan Allah a goodly loan so He may multiply it for that person many times over? And it is Allah who withholds and grants abundance, and to Him you will be returned."

— Surah Al-Baqarah 2:245 | The Holy Quran
